question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**Communiqe'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is 'Communiqe'.
 
• The correct spelling is 'Communique'.
 
• It refers to an official announcement or statement, often issued by a government, organization, or official authority. (आधिकारिक घोषणा)
 
 
• **Example:** *The government issued a **communique** to inform the public about the new policy changes.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelled word is 'Communiqe'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the other words:-

 
 
• **Inflammatory:** intended to cause very strong feelings of anger. (भड़काऊ)

 
 
• Example: The politician's **inflammatory** remarks heightened tensions among the audience.
 
 
 
• **Whether:** Used to refer to one or more possibilities or to express uncertainty.
 
 
• Example: I haven't decided **whether** to go to the party or stay home.
 
 
 
• **Zodiac:** It refers to an imaginary band in the heavens that encompasses the apparent paths of all the planets. (राशि)
 
 
• Example: Aries is the first sign of the** zodiac.**
